sloka: ते ऽन्तरिक्षाद्विनिर्धूतास्तस्य वेगेन राक्षसाः ।भूमौ निपतिताः सर्वे राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पश्यतः ।। ६.४१.८६ ।।।।
transliteration: te 'ntarikṣādvinirdhūtāstasya vegena rākṣasāḥ ।bhūmau nipatitāḥ sarve rākṣasendrasya paśyataḥ ।। 6.41.86 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Angada, the son of Tara, on his own wanting to exhibit his strength in the presence of the Rakshasa army allowed himself to be caught.
